body.message: Hi! I’m looking for a cozy one-bedroom apartment for about 3 months, from September 1 until December 17. My budget is around AED 5,000–5,500 per month. Ideally, I’d like something in JVC, Business Bay (or nearby) or Dubai Marina, but I’m open to other areas if it’s a nice place. Let me know if you have anything available. Thanks!
